svg.aria-label: Soccer Player Recruitment Model. Forecasts next-season goals plus assists per 90 for 941 Big-5 league players. R squared 0.68 on a held-out test set, 19 percent less error than last season's rate, ranking accuracy 0.82, 1,484 players forecast for 2026-27. Chart: predicted versus actual for 189 held-out players.
